_comment: ADR-0007 egress broker — per-App config template covering dev-1/2/3/4. Copy to a host-local path (e.g. ~/.ce-egress/broker.json), fill the real App ids + installation ids. Key source: use 'secret_ref' (vault-backed, preferred per ce-ops#266) or 'pem_path' (legacy, RAM-only via /dev/shm). Exactly one must be set per seat. The PEM is never read by the broker process — only by `openssl` at sign time. For secret_ref seats the broker fetches the key from OpenBao KV v2 per-call (RAM-only, never written to disk).

dev-1._comment: legacy pem_path — migrate to secret_ref when OpenBao is live for dev-1

dev-2._comment: legacy pem_path — dev-2 not yet migrated to OpenBao

dev-3._comment: vault-backed (ce-ops#266): App key stored in OpenBao KV v2 at ce-kv/forge/dev-3 field private_key

dev-4._comment: legacy pem_path — dev-4 not yet migrated to OpenBao
